props.name: record
props.comment: The record to render. Defaults to the ambient `RecordContext` value.

props.name: allowHalf
props.comment: Allow half-star granularity when the value falls between integers.

props.name: countSource
props.comment:
Sibling record field rendered in parentheses (e.g. a review count). A
top-level key, not a path: the read is `record[countSource]`.
